ValidationRule.description: Do not allow any changes to IDR system task if the subject is changed or the task is completed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT(ISNEW()), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'IDR_System_Task', OR ( NOT($UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Systemic_Issue_Team'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Systemic Issue')) ), OR ( PRIORVALUE(IsClosed), ISCHANGED(Subject) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not authorized to make updates to this record.
